0.original: Weitzaren, high miller of the Grey Fleet, requires the help of an able adventurer.

1.original: Weitzaren asks that you wreak vengeance on the galagos that robbed him of his milled grains, and recover the sacks of flour they stole.

2.original: You have delivered swift retribution to the thieving galagos. Take the recovered flour to Skarnmhar at the Red Rooster Stead.

3.original: Skarnmhar is appreciative of your help, but bemoans the fact the Stead hires no guards, and he must rely on the kindness of adventurers when things go awry.

24.original: Defeat the galagos and recover the sacks of flour.

25.original: Deliver the sacks of flour to Skarnmhar.

48.original: Now, felting wool is all well and good for your run-of-the-mill miller, but you know what gets my grindstone spinning? Grain!

49.original: What worth has wheat? None! But once shred into fabulous flour, even the confounded galagos can't keep their hands off of it.

50.original: Which is precisely why I need you to slay them and recover the four sacks they pilfered!

51.original: Once you have done so, take the sacks of flour down to the Stead, and Skarnmhar will take care of the rest.

52.original: All the eggs and milk in the world don't matter a lick without flour.

53.original: Not that flour's any good on its own, mind you. The galagos just hoard whatever they can get their filthy paws on.

54.original: But now we've got the whole kit and caboodle, thanks to you.

55.original: It's a relief you were around, but at the end of the day we're still utterly unprepared should this sort of thing happen again.
